title: Kenya population projections (KNBS)
description: County population projections from KNBS Volume XVI, used to grow census counts to the analysis year.

transfer.rationale: Re-run the ingest against its public origin rather than copying; the ingest is the definition of the dataset.

gaps: Source is a PDF with two known transcription defects.
County-growth and county-level projection methods differ by roughly 1.4 M people.

changelog.change: Record created; back-filled from the existing CDH record and ingest script.
Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.

acquire.note: Registered ingest. The script is the definition of the dataset; do not fetch these by any other route.
